compatibility: Ascension CoA 3.3.5 client, interface 30300; G1-compatible source family. Retail, Wrath Classic and arbitrary 3.3.5 clients are unverified.

upstream.role: Preserved public mirror of the Ascension backport; not asserted to be an official current release
upstream.original_project_status_at_audit: 404 from GitHub API; preserved README links to that project and directs installation through Ascension Launcher
upstream.archive_warning: Export-ignore omits GPL and library license files. Builder reads pinned Git blobs, never this incomplete archive.

license_scope.addon: Upstream GPL version 2 license text retained; no blanket relicensing of third-party components
license_scope.libraries: Original inline notices retained; Archivist CC0 and its LibDeflate LGPLv3 notices included
license_scope.fonts: Fira and PT Sans SIL OFL 1.1 notices retained
license_scope.sounds: Original author mapping in Provided by.txt retained with CC0, CC BY 3.0, CC BY-NC 3.0 and Sampling Plus 1.0 texts; media is not represented as unrestricted commercial content

local_comparison.method: Compare public pinned archive against six installed addon folders; no WTF or SavedVariables contents accessed
local_comparison.limitation: Identifies matching source family, not the historical delivery channel or original installer

changes.description: Require cooldown.expirationTime before arithmetic in PreShow; preserve existing G1 nil guard and add dated modification notice
